newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads four Nigerians for theft.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads four Nigerians for theft.

text.p: Saudi Arabia beheaded four Nigerian men on Sunday for robbing a jewellery store, Saudi state-television reported.
"(The four) burgled a jeweller's shop, tied up the worker in it, took large quantities of gold and jewellery and ran away," said an interior ministry statement carried on television.
The statement said the men had been executed in the western city of Mecca, the holiest pilgrimage site in Islam.
It was the first time this year that Saudi Arabia has beheaded people for theft.

The deaths bring the number of people executed in the conservative kingdom this year to 33. Saudi Arabia strictly enforces Islamic sharia law by beheading convicted murders, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
